info.name: GoTrack SE-2 API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive API test collection for the GoTrack Logistics platform covering auth-service, user-branch-service, and inventory-service. Includes auth flow, CRUD operations, service-to-service integration via Feign, error cases, and full data-flow test scenarios.

## Setup Instructions
1. Set environment variables before running:
   - `baseUrl_auth` → http://localhost:8080
   - `baseUrl_branch` → http://localhost:8080
   - `baseUrl_inventory` → http://localhost:8080
2. Run the 'Auth Flow' folder first to capture accessToken and refreshToken.
3. All subsequent requests use {{accessToken}} in the Authorization header.
